title: Custodian advisor portal user and sign-in settings
source_system: Custodian advisor portal settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: One adviser login, the owner's, with trading, fee instruction, account opening and money movement request permissions; the custodian enforces sign-in with an authenticator app; the app on the owner's phone is the only registered second factor and no backup sign-in method is registered; the portal keeps a sign-in and activity history

title: Custodian assets under management and account report
source_system: Custodian advisor portal reports (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About $19 million in client assets, all under discretionary authority, across about 140 accounts for about 70 client households (about 120 individual clients), all held at this custodian; every account owner is an individual; 5 households have addresses in other states, none in Colorado, and the rest in Florida

title: Custodian adviser service agreement and money movement procedures
source_system: Signed agreements folder; custodian advisor portal help pages
what_it_shows: The adviser may trade, instruct fee deductions and submit money movement requests for clients, and never holds client funds or securities; third-party wires need a letter of authorization signed by the client; the custodian runs its own review of third-party wire requests, including a call to the client on some of them; the custodian's adviser service desk takes trade orders by phone after identity checks; a SOC 1 Type 2 report is available on request, and none has been requested

title: Custodian money movement request history, January to June 2026
source_system: Custodian advisor portal (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Each money movement request the owner submitted carries the client's e-signed custodian form, sent for signature to the client's email address on file; the request records have no field or note for a call to the client before submission; requests that started as a client email or text are not marked

title: Near-miss email thread and custodian case note, 2026-06-18
source_system: Email inbox (SYS-04); custodian advisor portal messages (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: A message from a client's real email address asked for $36,000 to be wired to a new bank account; the owner sent the custodian's wire form for e-signature to that address; the custodian's case note records that its own call to the client stopped the wire; no record shows a call by the owner to the client, an entry in any log, or a report by the owner to the custodian

title: Portfolio and billing platform account security settings
source_system: Portfolio platform admin settings (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: One user, the owner, with administrator rights; password sign-in, with MFA available and turned off; daily data feed from the custodian; the platform keeps an activity history

title: Portfolio platform fee billing report, Q3 2025 to Q2 2026
source_system: Portfolio platform reports (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Fees billed quarterly in arrears on assets under management, about $45,000 a quarter; each quarter's fee file was submitted to the custodian through the advisor portal for deduction from client accounts; the owner's review of each fee calculation before submission is recorded; no payment card is used

title: Portfolio platform SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Portfolio platform vendor (provided under a nondisclosure agreement)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31; unqualified opinion; 1 exception (2 of 40 sampled terminated vendor employees kept access for more than 1 business day), remediated; encryption at rest and in transit, backup and 24x7 monitoring controls tested without exception; the system description states RTO 24 hours, RPO 4 hours and an annual recovery test; customers are notified of incidents without undue delay, with no fixed time; lists complementary user entity controls (customer MFA, prompt user removal, fee file review, notice of suspected compromise); the cloud hosting provider is a carved-out subservice organization

title: CRM account security settings and client records report
source_system: CRM admin settings and reports (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: One user, the owner, with administrator rights; password sign-in, with MFA available and turned off; records for about 160 consumers (about 120 current individual clients and about 40 former clients, the oldest from 2015) holding SSNs, dates of birth, ID images, phone numbers and other contact details, meeting notes, and uploaded onboarding documents; third-party apps are connected to the account, with no record of a review

title: Email and file suite admin console: plan, sign-in and retention settings
source_system: Email and file suite admin console (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Paid business plan with one licensed user, the owner, whose everyday mailbox is also the tenant administrator account; password sign-in, with MFA available and turned off; sign-in history kept 30 days; file version history kept 30 days; desktop sync to the laptop is on; no backup service is connected; third-party apps are connected to the mailbox, with no record of a review

title: Email and file suite business plan terms and data protection addendum
source_system: Provider website and admin console
what_it_shows: The business plan terms include the provider's data protection addendum with security commitments

title: Mailbox and file storage review
source_system: Email and file suite mailbox and file storage (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Client folders for current and former clients back to 2015, with statements, tax returns and onboarding forms; the mailbox holds the same kinds of documents as attachments; the sent folder shows a sample of client files sent to the compliance consultant for the annual review, and statements sent to some clients, as ordinary attachments; client requests for withdrawals and transfers arrive by ordinary email

title: Financial planning software account security settings
source_system: Financial planning software settings (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: One user, the owner; the vendor enforces MFA with the authenticator app on the owner's phone; client plans hold net worth, income and aggregated account data

title: E-signature service account settings and envelope history
source_system: E-signature admin settings (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: One user, the owner, with administrator rights; password sign-in, with MFA available and turned off; signing links go to the client's email address on file; the envelope history holds signed advisory agreements and custodian forms, including money movement forms

title: Accounting SaaS account security and data review
source_system: Accounting SaaS settings (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: One user, the owner, with administrator rights; password sign-in, with MFA available and turned off; records hold client names and fee amounts only

title: Browser saved passwords and password checkup
source_system: Web browser on the laptop (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Passwords for the business accounts are saved in the browser; the password checkup flags the email password as reused on two other sites; the other business passwords follow one pattern; no password manager is installed

title: Laptop settings review
source_system: Laptop settings screens (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption on; automatic operating system updates on and update history current; built-in antivirus on with real-time scanning and automatic signature updates; host firewall on; screen locks after 5 minutes idle; one user account, the owner's, signed in to every business service, and the owner states that a family member sometimes uses the laptop under that account; the desktop sync folder and the downloads folder hold client documents; the IT consultant's remote-support tool is installed and needs the owner to start each session

title: Mobile phone settings review
source_system: Mobile phone settings screens (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Passcode set; device encryption on; locks after 1 minute; automatic updates and built-in malware protection on; remote wipe not set up; holds the authenticator app with the second factors for the custodian portal and the financial planning software; no client documents in the photo roll

title: USB backup drive check
source_system: USB backup drive and laptop disk utility (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: The drive is not encrypted; it holds one full copy of the client folders, which the owner refreshes each week by plugging the drive into the laptop and copying over the previous copy; no older versions are kept

title: Home router settings and connected devices
source_system: Internet provider's router admin page (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: The router admin password is the default printed on the router label; one network serves the laptop, the phone, family devices and smart-home devices; no guest or separate network is in use; the firmware version is shown, and there is no record of a firmware check

title: Home office walk-through
source_system: Home office (observation)
what_it_shows: The home office door locks; paper client files are in a locked file cabinet; the USB backup drive is in an unlocked desk drawer; a cross-cut shredder is used for paper; a laptop from 2021 is in a closet and has never been wiped

title: AI assistant account settings and chat history
source_system: Consumer generative AI assistant, web and phone app (SYS-09)
what_it_shows: Consumer plan in the owner's name; chat history on; the setting that lets the vendor use chats to improve its models is on; chats since 2026-05-04, about 3 a week, summarize pasted or uploaded custodian statements and meeting notes and draft quarterly review letters; statements for about 25 client households were entered, some with full account numbers; a search of the chats found no SSNs

title: AI assistant consumer terms of service
source_system: AI assistant vendor website
what_it_shows: Click-through consumer terms; the vendor may use chats to improve its models unless the user turns that setting off; no written security, retention or deletion commitment for business data

title: Video meeting service settings
source_system: Video meeting service account settings
what_it_shows: The service offers an AI meeting summary feature; it is turned off, and the account shows no summaries

title: Signed agreements and vendor folder
source_system: Owner's agreements folder (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: On file: the custodian's custodial and adviser service agreements; the IT consultant's services agreement with confidentiality and security terms, signed 2026-07-10, and no earlier agreement; the compliance consultant's engagement letter for Form ADV updates and an annual compliance review on a sample of client files, with no security or confidentiality terms for client data; the outside CPA's engagement letter for the owner's tax return; subscription terms for the portfolio platform (with security commitments and a nondisclosure agreement for its SOC 2 report), the CRM, the email suite (with its data protection addendum), the planning software, the e-signature service and the accounting SaaS. Not located: a vendor list, any record of a vendor review, any assurance report or questionnaire from the CRM or e-signature vendor (the CRM vendor's security web page only), and any clause requiring a vendor to notify the adviser of an incident within a set time

title: Form ADV filing, compliance manual and privacy notice
source_system: Owner's compliance files (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Form ADV shows registration with the Florida OFR, a principal office in the owner's Florida home, about $19 million in discretionary assets under management, no fund clients, and fee-only advice with no other business activity (no broker-dealer, insurance or lending); the compliance manual prepared with the compliance consultant has one generic paragraph on information security; the privacy notice delivered to clients each year says the adviser maintains "physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards"

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents
source_system: Laptop; email and file suite; paper files
what_it_shows: Apart from the compliance manual paragraph, no written information security program, policy, risk assessment, Qualified Individual designation, list of where customer information is kept, device list, retention or disposal schedule, records index, incident plan, contact list, successor adviser or emergency access arrangement, vendor list, change record, test record, or record of any review of sign-ins, mailbox rules or platform activity was found

title: Continuing education record
source_system: Continuing education tracking account
what_it_shows: Courses completed cover compliance topics; no security course and nothing on business email compromise or social engineering

title: Bank and card statements, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the portfolio platform, CRM, email and file suite, financial planning software, e-signature service, accounting SaaS, video meeting service, phone carrier and internet provider; hourly payments to the IT consultant; fees to the compliance consultant and the outside CPA; an errors and omissions insurance premium and no cyber insurance premium; quarterly advisory fee deposits from the custodian

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files (prepared by the outside CPA)
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000 in advisory fees; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: Errors and omissions policy declarations
source_system: Insurance agent portal
what_it_shows: Errors and omissions policy in force for 2026; the declarations page lists the coverage forms but does not show whether a social engineering or cyber endorsement applies; the full policy form was requested from the agent

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Owner-adviser's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems and vendors used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; the owner is the only person with trading authority and the only one who can submit fee instructions or money movement requests; clients can call the custodian directly for withdrawals; the phone hotspot is the internet fallback

title: Risk walk-through of devices and accounts
source_system: Walk-through of the laptop, phone, USB drive and SaaS accounts with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: Where customer information ends up day to day (custodian portal, CRM, mailbox attachments, shared folders, the laptop sync and downloads folders, the USB drive, AI assistant chats); money movement requests received by email or text are acted on by sending the custodian's form for e-signature to the client's email address; the USB drive stays plugged in while it copies and is sometimes carried in the laptop bag; a family member sometimes uses the laptop under the owner's account; review letters drafted with the AI assistant were lightly edited before sending

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner-adviser's written answers to the 16 CFR 314.3 and 314.4 and Florida questions, checked on screen with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: The owner did not know Florida's 30-day individual notice clock or the FTC notice duty for events involving 500 or more consumers; there is no step to record when a possible incident was discovered; security setting changes and new tools are made with no record; the CRM, e-signature service and AI assistant were adopted with no security review; ransomware and hurricane threats had not been considered before this assessment; the owner has never been designated in writing as Qualified Individual

title: AI letter re-check
source_system: Sent mail (SYS-04); custodian statements (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: 5 review letters sent in June 2026 were re-checked against the custodian statements; one letter showed a return of 6.4% where the statement gave 6.1%; a correction was sent to that client

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register; P05 BIA; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment identifies 15 threat events with sources and vulnerabilities, rates likelihood and impact with Tables G-5 and I-2, includes harm to clients from disclosure and fraudulent payments, draws on the BIA, and is documented; results were shared with the IT consultant under the services agreement; no review frequency or update trigger was defined at the time of assessment

title: Control assessment: Vendor oversight review
source_system: Vendor contracts folder; compliance consultant engagement letter; AI assistant terms; portfolio platform SOC 2 report; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The compliance consultant receives client files with no security terms; the AI assistant is used under consumer terms that allow it to use pasted client data to improve its models; no required vendor safeguards, vendor list or oversight steps are documented; customer responsibilities are listed in the portfolio platform's SOC 2 report and the custodian's adviser agreement; only the portfolio platform was reviewed (SOC 2 review 2026-07-16), with no check of the CRM, e-signature or AI vendors

title: Control assessment: Administrator MFA sign-in test
source_system: Administrator sign-ins from a new browser to the email tenant, CRM, portfolio platform, e-signature and accounting services
what_it_shows: All five administrator accounts signed in with a password only; MFA is available on each and turned off

title: Control assessment: User MFA sign-in test
source_system: User sign-ins from a new browser to the custodian portal and the financial planning software
what_it_shows: The custodian portal user login and the financial planning login both required the authenticator app

title: Control assessment: Encryption status check
source_system: Encryption status of the laptop, phone and USB backup drive
what_it_shows: Laptop and phone encrypted; the USB backup drive holding every client folder has no encryption and no cryptographic protection against modification

title: Control assessment: Backup review and restore test
source_system: Email and file suite retention settings; USB drive contents; restore of 3 files from the USB drive; portfolio platform SOC 2 report
what_it_shows: Email and files keep 30 days of versions; the only independent copy is the weekly USB backup, which holds one version, is not encrypted, and stays connected during the copy; the compliance manual, Form ADV files and security documents exist only in the suite and the USB copy; each vendor backs up its own service (portfolio platform SOC 2 report, no exceptions) and the custodian keeps the records of account; 3 files were restored from the USB drive

title: Control assessment: Log and mailbox rule review
source_system: Email sign-in history and mailbox rules; CRM and portfolio platform activity pages; owner self-review
what_it_shows: Sign-in history, mailbox rules and platform activity had never been reviewed; the mailbox had one forwarding rule the owner did not recognize, sending messages containing "wire" to an outside address, and the owner deleted it during the session; the 30 days of sign-in history showed no foreign sign-ins; no process exists to act on review results or to increase review after an incident, a near miss or a vendor notice

title: Control assessment: Social engineering training self-review
source_system: Continuing education record; 2026-06-18 near-miss email thread; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No training on business email compromise, social engineering or social mining; the 2026-06-18 request from a real client address was not recognized by the owner; the near miss was not logged or reported to the custodian by the owner; no reporting step exists for suspected social engineering or social mining

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting self-review
source_system: Contact lists; vendor contracts (notice clauses); owner self-review
what_it_shows: No reporting time is defined; vendor contracts do not require prompt notice to the adviser; there is no list of whom to notify (custodian fraud line, counsel, Florida notices, FTC count check)
